meta.note: HAND-AUTHORED (plan P2-11). Exists so the Phase-2 e2e sweep (`tests/e2e/browse.spec.ts`) can click a search-result card into a watch route that actually renders comments: the comment fixtures (`comments-basic`/`comments-newest`) key on `dQw4w9WgXcQ|top`/`|newest`, and `CommentsSection` only mounts inside the watch route's `detail ?` branch. The channel id `UC1111111111111111111111` deliberately matches `channel-videos.json` / `channel-playlists.json` (Lofi Girl) and the pinned author in `comments-basic.json`, so a comment author link walks to a fixtured channel route. URLs are synthetic and redacted; no streaming_data because the sweep never presses play (P1-6 click-to-play).
